tools.name: batch_cancel
tools.intent: Cancel up to 8 web automation runs by id in one call; only when the user explicitly asks to stop them.

tools.name: batch_status
tools.intent: Poll status and results of up to 8 automation runs by id; use after launching several runs, every 30 to 60 seconds.

tools.name: cancel_monitor
tools.intent: Delete a TinyFish Monitor and its schedule; only when the user explicitly asks to remove it.

tools.name: cancel_profile_setup_session
tools.intent: Close a profile sign-in setup session and discard unsaved state; use to abandon a login without saving.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.intent: Cancel one web automation run by id; only on explicit user request, never because it is slow.

tools.name: close_browser_session
tools.intent: Close a remote browser session by id so it stops running; idempotent cleanup after create_browser_session.

tools.name: create_browser_session
tools.intent: Open a remote stealth Chrome session and return CDP details for Playwright or Puppeteer control; for low-level browser control.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.intent: Create a recurring Monitor that watches a URL or search topic on a cron schedule and returns a baseline; billed per run.

tools.name: create_profile
tools.intent: Create a Browser Context Profile that stores cookies and sign-in state for later automation runs.

tools.name: fetch_content
tools.intent: Free page reader that returns clean markdown, html or json for up to 10 URLs in parallel; default for reading known URLs.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.intent: Read one Monitor by id, including its config, schedule and status.

tools.name: get_run
tools.intent: Retrieve status, result and error of one automation run by id; use to poll after a timeout or async start.

tools.name: get_search_usage
tools.intent: List past search usage records with date and status filters; use for audits, not to verify setup.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.intent: Read wallet balance, auto-reload state and contract rates; read-only, use before or after insufficient-credit errors.

tools.name: guide_next_step
tools.intent: Return the next interactive TinyFish onboarding step based on real usage; ask the user before acting on it.

tools.name: list_browser_sessions
tools.intent: List browser sessions with status and date filters; use to find running or past sessions.

tools.name: list_fetch_usage
tools.intent: List past fetch_content requests with date and status filters, without page content; use for audits.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.intent: List all Monitors with id, type, target, schedule and status.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.intent: List Browser Context Profiles, the default, and which sites each is signed in to; check before authenticated runs.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.intent: List automation runs filtered by status, goal text or date; use to recover a run id after a timeout.

tools.name: pause_monitor
tools.intent: Pause a Monitor schedule until resumed; only when the user asks.

tools.name: resume_monitor
tools.intent: Resume a paused TinyFish Monitor so its recurring schedule starts running again; counterpart of pause_monitor.

tools.name: run_monitor
tools.intent: Run a Monitor once immediately and return that result; only when the user wants a check now.

tools.name: run_web_automation
tools.intent: Run a natural-language interactive task on one website (click, forms, login) and wait for the result; metered, may take minutes.

tools.name: run_web_automation_async
tools.intent: Start one web automation in the background and return a run id; only when the user explicitly asks for background execution.

tools.name: save_profile_setup_session
tools.intent: Save cookies and storage from a manual sign-in session onto a profile and close the browser, recording signed-in sites.

tools.name: search
tools.intent: Free web search returning compact structured results with geo, language, date, news and research-paper filters; default for finding pages.

tools.name: start_profile_setup_session
tools.intent: Open a live browser so the user signs in by hand to a site, returning a viewer URL; follow with save_profile_setup_session.

tools.name: top_up_wallet
tools.intent: Add funds to the TinyFish wallet over MPP payment, in two calls; only after the user agrees to the amount.
